elements.requirement: A lasting power of attorney is a power of attorney under which the donor ('P') confers authority on the donee or donees to make decisions about all or any of P's personal welfare (or specified matters concerning it) and P's property and affairs (or specified matters concerning it), including authority to make such decisions when P no longer has capacity.
elements.quote: A lasting power of attorney is a power of attorney under which the donor (“P”) confers on the donee (or donees) authority to make decisions about all or any of the following— (a) P's personal welfare or specified matters concerning P's personal welfare, and (b) P's property and affairs or specified matters concerning P's property and affairs, and which includes authority to make such decisions in circumstances where P no longer has capacity.

elements.requirement: A lasting power of attorney is not created unless section 10 is complied with.
elements.quote: A lasting power of attorney is not created unless— (a) section 10 is complied with

elements.requirement: A lasting power of attorney is not created unless an instrument conferring authority of the kind mentioned in section 9(1) is made and registered in accordance with Schedule 1.
elements.quote: an instrument conferring authority of the kind mentioned in subsection (1) is made and registered in accordance with Schedule 1

elements.requirement: A lasting power of attorney is not created unless the donor ('P') has reached 18 years of age at the time P executes the instrument.
elements.quote: at the time when P executes the instrument, P has reached 18

elements.requirement: A lasting power of attorney is not created unless the donor ('P') has capacity to execute the instrument at the time P executes it.
elements.quote: at the time when P executes the instrument, P has reached 18 and has capacity to execute it.

elements.requirement: An instrument confers no authority if it purports to create a lasting power of attorney but does not comply with section 9, section 10, or Schedule 1.
elements.quote: An instrument which— (a) purports to create a lasting power of attorney, but (b) does not comply with this section, section 10 or Schedule 1, confers no authority.

elements.requirement: The authority conferred by a lasting power of attorney is subject to the provisions of the Mental Capacity Act 2005, and in particular sections 1 (the principles) and 4 (best interests).
elements.quote: The authority conferred by a lasting power of attorney is subject to— (a) the provisions of this Act and, in particular, sections 1 (the principles) and 4 (best interests)

elements.requirement: The authority conferred by a lasting power of attorney is subject to any conditions or restrictions specified in the instrument.
elements.quote: any conditions or restrictions specified in the instrument.

thresholds.what: minimum age the donor ('P') must have reached at the time of executing the instrument for a lasting power of attorney to be created
